title: Days of the week strip and calendar page
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: The weekend; Basem in the village; the little mouse and the lion
source: Written for arabic/y4 lesson 3 (Days of the week strip and calendar page (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 3: The weekend and the days of the week. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: The weekend
points: Today is: اليَوْمُ يَوْمُ الاِثْنَيْنِ (al-yawm yawm al-ithnayn)

panels.title: What I do at the weekend
points: أَزُورُ جَدَّتِي (azuru jaddati) I visit my grandmother
أُسَاعِدُ أُمِّي (usa'idu ummi) I help my mother
أَقْرَأُ القُرْآنَ (aqra'u l-qur'an) I read the Qur'an

blocks.task: put them in order, starting with الأَحَد.

blocks.text: Write the dates of this month under each day. Circle the weekend: السَّبْت وَالأَحَد.

questions.q: Say 'At the weekend I help my mother.'
Core: Write the seven days in Arabic in order, starting with الأَحَد.
questions.a: الأَحَد، الاِثْنَيْن، الثُّلَاثَاء، الأَرْبِعَاء، الخَمِيس، الجُمُعَة، السَّبْت

questions.q: Extend: Write two sentences about your weekend, starting فِي نِهَايَةِ الأُسْبُوعِ.
questions.a: For example: فِي نِهَايَةِ الأُسْبُوعِ أَزُورُ جَدَّتِي. فِي نِهَايَةِ الأُسْبُوعِ أَقْرَأُ القُرْآنَ.

questions.q: Stretch: Which day is your favourite, and why? Write it in English, then the day in Arabic.
questions.a: For example: الجُمُعَة, because I go to Jumu'ah.
B) Thursday. الخَمِيس comes from خَمْسَة (five): the fifth day, Thursday.

questions.q: What is the weekend in Arabic? A) نِهَايَةُ الأُسْبُوعِ B) يَوْمُ الجُمُعَةِ C) أُسْبُوع
Big question: say one thing you do at the weekend in Arabic.
questions.a: For example: فِي نِهَايَةِ الأُسْبُوعِ أَزُورُ جَدَّتِي.
